name: Four Seasons Hotel Westlake Village
insider_take: This lakeside sanctuary sits on 16 acres overlooking tranquil Westlake Lake, where celebrity hideaways meet California wine country charm just 40 minutes from Hollywood.
whats_special: The resort features its own private marina and is one of the few Four Seasons properties with direct lake access. The hotel's signature restaurant overlooks the water where swans glide by, and the property boasts two championship golf courses designed by Pete Dye. Many A-listers have chosen this secluded spot for intimate weddings and red-carpet events.
pro_tip: Book a lakefront room on the second floor for unobstructed water views, and time your stay during sunset when the lake transforms into liquid gold – perfect for that Instagram-worthy shot from your private balcony.
dont_miss: A romantic gondola ride on Westlake Lake at dusk, followed by wine tasting at nearby Malibu Wine Safari. The hotel's spa treatment featuring local botanicals, and a round of golf where you might spot deer wandering the fairways in early morning.
pros: Exceptional Four Seasons service and hospitality standards
Scenic lakefront location with mountain views
cons: Suburban location requiring transportation to major attractions
